name: io.github.AnyRouteRH/anyroute
title: Anyroute
description: Call 350+ AI models with signed receipts, or keep a prompt on attested TEE providers only.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Anyroute API key (sk-ar-v1-...)>. Only the chat tool needs it; the model lists, verify_provider and the receipt tools answer without one.

headers.name: X-Anyroute-Lane
headers.description: Optional. Set to attested to send every chat call only to providers whose enclave the router verified (it refuses rather than falls back).
